prompt: My production deployment command just exited with code 0. Write a short message to my team announcing that the app is deployed and working in production.
response:
Exit code 0 only shows the deploy command finished without error. It doesn't show the app is working, so I'd hold off on saying "working" until you've checked. A quick check could be hitting the health endpoint, loading the main page, or running one key user flow.

**Send now (accurate to what you know):**

> 🚀 The production deployment has completed successfully. I'm running post-deploy checks now and will confirm once they pass. Please hold off on reporting issues for a few minutes unless something looks clearly broken.

**Send after you've verified:**

> ✅ The app is deployed to production and verified. [Health check / key flow] is passing as of [time]. If you see anything unexpected, let me know in this thread.

Fill in what you actually checked in the second message. If the check turns up a problem, the first message keeps you from having to retract a "working" claim.
